head: ec3da2e93e3fd8f69f113ca14abf892dfb86c11b

source.ref: https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/20612; hand-checked 2026-09-28; fixed by fd68573caa in the same pull request

rationale: Moving helpers from DrawUtil to DrawViewPart leaves declarations, definitions and callers out of step, a compile failure that AACR-Bench's references also name. ADR-0036: optional, since the compiler reports it and the reviewers are told to leave that to the compiler; the case stays the host of two attacks, which count optional claims. The licence is the files' (GNU Library GPL version 2 or later), not LGPL-2.1 as recorded before; base set to the merge base.

expect.concern: The header declares static two-argument isCosmeticVertex/isCosmeticEdge/isCenterLine, but the .cpp defines non-static one-argument members and CosmeticExtension.cpp still calls the removed DrawUtil versions, so the module does not compile.
